source: IDX ESG Disclosure Guide Book (EDGB). Codes and descriptions confirmed live against BANK-BCA's own bilingual index table (p.8/17) and, where the index label was ambiguous, cross-checked against the real value row itself (p.5/15) — same discipline as `checklists/edgb/environmental.json`.
note_on_S-12: The Indonesian index table (p.8) mislabels S-12 as 'Pencegahan Konflik Kepentingan' (Conflict of Interest Prevention) — the same label G-09 legitimately carries. The English index table (p.17) and both languages' real value rows (p.5: 'Perusahaan memiliki aktivitas CSR...'; p.15: 'Does the company have CSR activities, investments or donations...') agree it is Corporate Social Responsibility, not conflict of interest. This checklist uses the value-row-grounded description, not the mislabelled index entry — the same 'never trust a single row's label' discipline the mislabelled-GHG-row defect (docs/architecture.md, 2026-07-25) already established for this corpus.

items.description: Gender equality: the composition of the bank's workforce by gender.
Employees by gender and age group: headcount broken down by gender and age bracket.
Employee turnover rate: the rate at which employees leave the bank during the reporting year.
Number of temporary employees: the count of non-permanent staff.
Employee training and development: the training and development activity provided to employees during the reporting year.
Number of work accidents: the count and/or rate of work-related accidents during the reporting year.
Human rights violation incidents: the number of incidents regarding human rights abuse in the reporting year.
Sexual harassment and/or non-discrimination policy: whether the bank has a policy regarding sexual harassment and/or non-discrimination.
Human rights policy: whether the bank has a policy regarding human rights.
Child labor and/or forced labor policy: whether the bank has a policy regarding child labor and/or forced labor.
Occupational health and safety policy: whether the bank has a policy on occupational health and safety and a safe, decent working environment for all employees.

Corporate Social Responsibility: whether the bank has CSR activities, investments, or donations to the community or registered non-profit organizations. Note: the Indonesian index table mislabels this code as conflict-of-interest prevention; the value row itself (both languages) is unambiguously CSR — see `note_on_S-12` above.
